findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (high). Unenforced DMARC increases spoofing, business email compromise and wire-fraud risk around transaction communications.

remediation.summary: Review DMARC reports, then progress policy from p=none to quarantine and reject after validating legitimate senders.

findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (medium). Softfail weakens protection against unauthorized senders using the domain.

remediation.summary: Inventory authorized senders and change the SPF qualifier from ~all to -all once legitimate sources are confirmed.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (low). Missing DNSSEC reduces DNS integrity protection but is not by itself evidence of compromise.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC with the DNS provider or registrar and verify DS records and resolution after signing.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (medium). Public exposure of VPN, automation, staging and legacy names increases attack-surface and diligence risk; the CT evidence does not establish that each host is currently reachable or vulnerable.

remediation.summary: Validate ownership and current reachability, restrict administrative and staging access, and remove or decommission obsolete systems.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (low). A broad certificate footprint increases the likelihood of unmanaged assets and incomplete attack-surface inventories.

remediation.summary: Reconcile all 47 CT hostnames against the authoritative asset inventory and retire or formally risk-accept unmanaged systems.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (medium). Deprecated TLS on www increases protocol-security and customer or regulatory compliance risk.

remediation.summary: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 on www.brightwaterfleet.example and confirm remaining clients can use TLS 1.2 or higher.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (low). Missing HSTS permits potential protocol-downgrade exposure for web users.

remediation.summary: Deploy a Strict-Transport-Security header on both hosts after confirming all subresources and redirects operate over HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS not set

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (critical). This is a potential exposure only: the match is based on a version string from a public page and was not verified on the host, so urgent validation is a pre-close diligence priority rather than a confirmed exploitable condition.

evidence.excerpt: ExampleGate SSL-VPN 7.0.11 matched CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001; basis=version string from public page; not verified on host

remediation.summary: Immediately confirm whether ExampleGate SSL-VPN 7.0.11 is deployed and reachable, then patch, upgrade, restrict access or remove it if the potential exposure is confirmed.

findings.title: Potential exposure to a CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability

findings.deal_impact: Severity retained at baseline (high). A breach notice disclosed 14 months before collection creates follow-up diligence, regulatory, customer-notification and incident-response maturity risk.

evidence.excerpt: 2025-08-14 state AG breach notice: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified

remediation.summary: Obtain the incident report and closure evidence, verify corrective actions and any outstanding obligations, and assess residual customer and regulatory exposure.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months
